$comment: The metric dictionary, versioned with the corpus rather than inside either tool's bench/. Seeded with the one metric this corpus publishes about itself; finding-quality metrics arrive with the labels/ ground truth.

detection.recall.population: findable failure cases in qa-corpus, partitioned independently by grading level, failure mode, and language
detection.recall.method: cases for which the runner emits the expected finding at L1, the expected locus at L2, and the expected actionable message fragments at L3, divided by seeded cases in the same mode-language partition; levels are never collapsed
detection.recall.note: Every observation carries bounds.gap_count beside it. Missing L2 or L3 ground truth scores as not reached, so adding a shallow fixture cannot manufacture deep recall.

bounds.gap_count.population: every cell declared in corpus.yaml's bounds matrix
bounds.gap_count.method: count of cells in state GAP
bounds.gap_count.note: A COUNT, never a ratio (FR-065-CON-2). A ratio falls as easy cases are added, so a corpus could improve its number while the hard missing case stayed missing.
